scripts.build: pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm run build:mobile
scripts.build:desktop: vite build && pnpm exec cap sync @capacitor-community/electron && pnpm exec cap copy @capacitor-community/electron
scripts.build:mobile: vite build && pnpm exec cap sync android ios
scripts.build:android: vite build && pnpm exec cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: vite build && pnpm exec cap sync ios
scripts.run:desktop: pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm exec cap open @capacitor-community/electron
scripts.run:android: pnpm run build:android && pnpm exec cap open android
scripts.run:ios: pnpm run build:ios && pnpm exec cap open ios
